prompt:
Summarize the following document in 2-4 sentences for a busy reader.

Northwind Outfitters reported third-quarter revenue of $48.2 million, up 14% from the same quarter last year. Online sales made up 41% of revenue, compared with 33% a year earlier. Gross margin fell to 52.1% from 53.4%, which the company attributed to higher freight costs. During the quarter Northwind opened two stores, in Denver and Austin, and closed its Portland location. CEO Maria Delgado said the company expects full-year revenue between $190 million and $195 million and plans to hire about 120 warehouse staff ahead of the holiday season. The company did not change its dividend.
output: Northwind's Q3 revenue grew 14% to $48.2M, with online sales at 41% of revenue. Freight costs pushed gross margin down to 52.1%. Full-year guidance is $190-195M.

Researchers at the University of Leeds studied how sleep affects memory in 64 adults aged 18 to 30. Participants were split into two groups: one slept eight hours a night and the other five hours a night, for four nights. Both groups then learned a list of words. The eight-hour group recalled 23% more words on average. The effect was strongest for emotionally charged words. The authors note the sample was small and young, so the results may not generalise to older adults. The study was published in the Journal of Sleep Research.
output: A Leeds study found adults who slept eight hours for four nights recalled 23% more words than five-hour sleepers, especially emotional words; the small, young sample limits generalisation.

Riverton city council voted 7-2 on Tuesday to close Main Street to cars between 3rd and 9th Avenue, starting June 1. The closure is a six-month pilot. Delivery vehicles will still be allowed from 6 a.m. to 10 a.m. The pilot will cost $1.2 million, mostly for new benches, planters and signage. Local business owners were split: restaurant owners largely supported the plan, while several retailers worried about losing customers who drive. The council will review foot traffic and sales data in December before deciding whether to make the closure permanent.
output: Riverton will pilot a car-free Main Street from June 1 for six months, costing $1.2M, with morning deliveries allowed and a December review.

On March 3, the payments API was unavailable for 47 minutes, from 14:12 to 14:59 UTC. About 12% of card transactions failed during this window; customers who retried after 14:59 succeeded. The root cause was an expired TLS certificate on an internal load balancer, which caused health checks to fail and traffic to be dropped. No payment data was lost or duplicated. The on-call engineer identified the cause after 31 minutes and rotated the certificate manually. Follow-up actions: automate certificate rotation for all internal load balancers, and alert 30 days before any certificate expires.
output: A 47-minute payments outage on March 3 was caused by an expired internal TLS certificate; 12% of transactions failed and no data was lost. Certificate rotation will be automated.
